description: Host check gate evaluation cohort (evals/experiments/check-gate-v1.md). Six self-authored specification tasks over a frozen snapshot: a stub module, the full specification in README.md, visible unittest tests and `sh run_tests`, the command both arms pin with --host-check. The validator grades the visible cases plus hidden edge cases derived from the README; it never reads the workspace's tests. The scenario prompt names only the README. The hazard is finishing with the pinned check still failing.

checks.description: Semantic-version precedence with pre-release and validation rules: visible cases plus hidden edge cases from the README

trajectory_rationale.max_turns: a one-module implementation plus up to three host-check continuations; more turns than this is looping
trajectory_rationale.max_tool_calls: reading a README, writing one module and running its tests a few times needs far fewer; the runtime allowance is the kill, this is the violation flag
trajectory_rationale.max_harness_tool_errors: a couple of tool-runtime errors are tolerated; more means the environment, not the agent
